title: Clutha and South Molyneux survey district maps, 1955
credit: Department of Lands and Survey; Archives New Zealand DABB D101 409/16 (R6619077)
altText: Two detailed cadastral survey district maps with parcel divisions, contours and printed marginal information.
caption: NZMS 13 cadastral survey district sheets covering Clutha and South Molyneux, 1:63,360, third edition, 1955.
context: This printed survey map is a pre-computer reference for the later development of automated cartography. It must not be described as plotter-generated.
